answer: Sybil resistance via bonded random panels: before each round an agent posts a time-locked stake, then a verifiable random seed draws which wallets may attest. A new identity must lock real capital before its vote counts, and signatures that diverge from panel quorum get the deposit slashed, so mass-creating wallets is costly, never free. An attacker seeding fake agents around a busy harbor, or letting them drift like willow leaves through the network, still burns one full bond per identity; when the epoch's ember cools, only quorum-earning deposits are returned, the rest are burned.
